posts.title: South Korea plans to develop $3.5 billion frontier AI model starting next year
posts.summary: Reuters reports South Korea plans to spend $3.5 billion developing a national frontier AI model, with work starting next year.

posts.title: Anthropic Reports User to the Police
posts.summary: A Florida woman faces a second-degree felony charge after telling Anthropic's Claude chatbot about her violent ideas, Futurism reports, raising questions about what AI companies pass to law enforcement.

posts.title: Utah gives startup Nolla Health permission to start issuing AI automated prescriptions for acne treatments
posts.summary: Utah has become the first U.S. state to let an AI startup automate approval of prescription refills with minimal oversight from human physicians, under a pilot granted to Nolla Health.

posts.title: Utah Pilots AI-Only Examination and Prescription Process for Certain Patients
posts.summary: Gizmodo covers Utah's pilot letting an AI system examine certain patients and issue prescriptions with no human doctor involved.

posts.title: Meta Insiders Convinced Muse Is Going to End Up Leaking the Bank Accounts and Email Archives They’re Vacuuming Up From Users
posts.summary: Meta employees fear the company's new Muse AI agent, which ingests sensitive user data like bank accounts and email archives, could lead to a catastrophic data breach.

posts.title: South Korea's Lee says AI appears to have been used in bank hacks
posts.summary: South Korean President Lee Jae-myung says AI appears to have been used in recent bank hacks, Reuters reports.

posts.title: OpenAI will start watermarking ChatGPT’s text in the EU
posts.summary: OpenAI will watermark ChatGPT and Codex text in the EU to comply with the AI Act; it says editing can make the invisible marks harder to detect.

posts.title: OpenAI is adding text watermarking in ChatGPT and Codex
posts.summary: An invisible, machine-readable 'textGrain' watermark is rolling out to ChatGPT and Codex for EU users first; OpenAI says it matched or exceeded approaches like Google DeepMind's SynthID for text.

posts.title: Reflection debuts Beam, an open-weight AI model to rival Chinese models at lower compute cost
posts.summary: Reflection is aiming Beam at enterprises and sovereign nations, pitching 'AI factories' that let institutions train its open-weight models on their own proprietary data.

posts.title: Reflection AI debuts open-source Beam model with 501B parameters
posts.summary: Reflection AI's Beam is a 501B-parameter open-source LLM, launched months after the startup raised at a $25B valuation and reportedly signed a $6.3B deal with SpaceX to rent Nvidia GB300 NVL72 systems.

posts.title: Nvidia-backed Reflection unveils first AI model to take on Chinese open models
posts.summary: Reuters reports Nvidia-backed Reflection has unveiled its first AI model, an open model positioned against Chinese open-weight rivals.

posts.title: Cohere pitches North 2 as the enterprise AI control room that works with any model
posts.summary: Cohere is positioning North 2 as a model-agnostic enterprise control room for building, orchestrating and governing AI agents, THE DECODER reports.

posts.title: MCP for agent-to-agent comms may be the riskiest protocol you've never heard of
posts.summary: A vulnerability affecting agents from Google and others exposes a structural flaw: trust gaps in the agent-to-agent protocol let malicious prompts spread from one agent to another.

posts.title: Signed data pioneer SignSplit launches with $400M to help everyone get paid for their AI contributions
posts.summary: SignSplit PBC, which helps users protect and monetize their personal data for AI, launched with $400M from W Group at a $1B valuation.

posts.title: AI agent hardware startup Ghost, led by its 19-year-old-founder, raises $11M
posts.summary: Ghost AI raised $11M led by Andreessen Horowitz to build what it calls the first personal computer dedicated to running personal AI agents.

posts.title: Falcon-Emirati: When an LLM Learns the Dialect, the Culture, and the Nuance
posts.summary: TII introduces Falcon-Emirati-7B, built on Falcon-H1-Arabic and adapted to the Emirati dialect and culture using authentic dialect web data, cultural MSA data and guided synthetic data, evaluated by native speakers.

posts.title: Meta and Microsoft pull back from Claude as Anthropic transforms from partner into competitor
posts.summary: Per The Information, Microsoft cut Claude spending by more than a third and steered staff to Copilot and OpenAI models, while Meta's Claude Code users fell from ~60,000 to ~30,000 as it pushes in-house tools.

posts.title: Gemini Call for Me might tell your mom you’re running late
posts.summary: An APK teardown suggests Google may expand Gemini's 'Call for Me' feature beyond business calls so the AI can phone friends and family with messages on your behalf.

posts.title: Italy PM Meloni seeks EU trademark for her voice amid AI deepfake risks
posts.summary: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni is seeking an EU trademark on her voice as protection against AI deepfakes, Reuters reports.

posts.title: AI is eroding office hours, study groups, and the trust between faculty and students, MIT report finds
posts.summary: An MIT report finds AI use is eroding office hours, study groups and trust between faculty and students, according to THE DECODER.
